Phuket to Krabi and Phi Phi

In season, a morning ferry or van covers Phuket to Krabi, and boats cover both to Phi Phi. In the southwest monsoon, treat boat days as optional.

Phuket-Krabi vanAbout 2.5 to 3 hours via the bridge
Boat to Phi Phi1.5 to 2 hours from either side
SeasonLock boats November to April

Krabi airport (KBV) is the other Andaman door. Flying BKK-KBV then boating to Phi Phi is cleaner than landing HKT at 16:00 and hoping.

Ways to go

ModeTimeNotes
Van or car, Phuket to Krabi2.5-3 hoursThe reliable move in any month.
Ferry to Phi Phi1.5-2 hoursMorning departures. Cancel when the Andaman is up.
Speedboat loopsLong dayFour-island tours. Book on Klook, sleep on land that night.

Common questions

Can you do Phi Phi as a day trip?
Yes from Phuket or Ao Nang. Stay the night if you want the village after the last tour boat.
What about KBV flights?
Use them when Krabi or Railay is the base. Search BKK-KBV on Trip.com the same way you search HKT.
